title: The Kite with a Long Tail
youtube_title: The Kite with a Long Tail | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a kite tail of bows that had to be tied the same distance apart will go wrong if one person rushes. Remy and Gio split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
